scenes.headline: How a 1B maths model keeps its cache small
scenes.sub: Limite 1B - Violetto, read from its config.json.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Confetti! Limite 1B Violetto is a small maths model sold as high-throughput. Its config shows why.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Three of every four blocks only look back 1,024 tokens. Only 12 of 48 keep a cache that grows, so long problems stay cheap to hold.
scenes.say: Three blocks in four look back only a thousand and twenty-four tokens. Just twelve of forty-eight keep a growing cache.

scenes.title: A speedrun parts list
scenes.say: Most parts read like a speedrun changelog, and cost nothing at inference.

items.say: A second embedding table feeds sixteen blocks' value path straight from the token id.
Two dense shortcuts, at half-way and the exit, reach back to earlier blocks.
Norms have no learnable gain, and the attention scale is pinned at zero point one.

steps.label: 36 windowed blocks: the last 1,024 tokens
steps.say: A windowed block looks back a thousand and twenty-four tokens, with short rotary positions on half its channels.

steps.label: 12 global blocks: everything, no positions
steps.say: Every fourth block is global: it sees everything, with no positions at all.

scenes.title: One token, one block
scenes.text: 2 x 2 KV heads x 128 x 2 bytes = 1,024 B
scenes.say: What does one token cost a block?

parts.note: keys and values; 10 query heads share 2 KV heads
parts.say: Keys and values, for two KV heads. Ten query heads share them.

parts.note: head dimension, at 2 bytes a number
parts.say: Each head is a hundred and twenty-eight wide, two bytes a number.

parts.note: global block at 131,072 tokens: 134 MB; windowed: 1.05 MB
parts.say: A thousand and twenty-four bytes. At a hundred and thirty-one thousand tokens, a global block holds a hundred and thirty-four megabytes; a windowed one, about one.

scenes.title: KV cache at 131,072 tokens
scenes.note: on one 80 GB card: 44 long sequences instead of 11
scenes.say: One point six five gigabytes in all, not six point four four. An eighty gigabyte card fits forty-four long problems, not eleven.

scenes.title: The release's headline chart
scenes.credit: Paradigma's release blog, its headline figure

steps.say: The release's headline chart is about maths, not speed. Violetto is the purple dot, far left of models scoring the same.
Its footnote: reinforcement learning is excluded, and counted stages differ by model.

scenes.text: High throughput here means concurrency: a mostly windowed cache fits 44 long problems where 11 would. A ceiling, not a measurement.
scenes.say: High throughput here means concurrency: forty-four long problems, not eleven. A ceiling from the config, not a measurement.

recap: The cache at 131K drops from 6.44 to 1.65 GB
scenes.say: Windowed blocks, a few global ones without positions, and a much smaller cache.
